name: Tarashi Wolff-Adeyemi
description: Considered the foundational figure of neural-feed acting, Wolff-Adeyemi's work in the late 2180s established the performance vocabulary that nearly every subsequent neural-feed actor has been trained against. Of Japanese-German-Yoruba descent, she developed a technique she called 'interior weather' — a method of generating slow-building emotional states that translated through BCI with unprecedented clarity. She retired from performance in 2207 and now teaches at a private studio in Tier 3, refusing all corporate affiliation.
cultural_impact: The Wolff-Adeyemi Method is now the standard curriculum in every licensed and unlicensed neural-feed acting program in M88, meaning her influence shapes nearly every performance audiences experience.
story_hooks: A Vantablack subsidiary is using archived captures of her early performances to train an AI actor, and the synthetic signature is indistinguishable from her original — she wants it stopped.
A former student who went underground contacts her claiming to have been psychologically damaged by a production that pushed the Method beyond ethical limits.
She is writing a memoir that names specific Vantablack executives who she believes knowingly exploited early performers, and the legal threats are already arriving.
